'''Swang''' was the leader of a [[Swang's Swoopers|swoop gang]] that operated in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He usually wore a red tunic and black pants.<ref name="MEAS" />
